critical_code_review_comments: services/email.py::_send_email_impl: 'errors' dict keys by short provider id but Resend fallback uses labels['resend']. Correct today because labels is patched at line 218, but consider centralizing the id→label map to avoid a KeyError regression if a new provider id is added.

routers/admin.py::admin_setup_status: gmail_ok is set from gmail_token OR gmail_service_account, but active_map treats 'gmail' and 'gmail_sa' identically. If only the service account is configured but provider='gmail' (personal OAuth), the pill shows 'Gmail (active)' even though the true active path is the SA. Consider distinguishing gmail_token vs gmail_service_account to avoid misleading operators.

seed_data_creation: Test class TestEmailDiagnostics temporarily set email_provider=mailgun with an invalid Mailgun key (domain=invalid.stitches.test, api_key=key-TEST_iter39_invalid_diag_key). Teardown restores the original email_provider snapshot; mailgun-config credentials were NOT restored to a prior state (the previous config, if any, remains overwritten with the invalid test value). TestBotsRegression created TEST_iter39_bot and deleted it in cleanup. NOTE: if the environment previously had a real Mailgun key configured for testing, an admin will need to re-enter it via /admin > Email; because we cannot read the encrypted key back, we can't perfectly restore it. Preview env showed no valid key beforehand (email was already failing), so this should be a no-op for this environment.
